interface.shortDescription: MCP tools for SEC-grounded stress, alpha, and fundamentals intelligence with free calls and payment fallback.
interface.longDescription: DeltaSignal ATLAS gives Codex an MCP-first tool surface for usage-based issuer intelligence on crypto public companies. It exposes readiness checks, covenant stress screens, top-stressed issuers, peer ranking, alpha signals, fundamentals, and daily SEC change snapshots, with a 5-call free starter tier plus Tempo MPP and Base x402 compatibility rails.
defaultPrompt: Use DeltaSignal ATLAS to check whether the current issuer slice is ready.
Use DeltaSignal ATLAS to find the top stressed crypto public issuers.
Use DeltaSignal ATLAS to compare MARA against its peer covenant stress ranking.
